rationale: The sensor fails to come online even with a new battery, after reset, and when placed next to the base station. Other sensors from the same box work, ruling out setup or base station issues. This points to a hardware fault in the sensor itself.

output.symptom_summary: Workshop sensor remains offline despite new battery, reset, and proximity to base station; other sensors work normally.
output.suspected_root_cause: Hardware fault in the sensor (e.g., radio failure, internal defect).
key_abnormal_indicators: Other sensors from same box work
output.customer_reply: Thank you for the details. Since the sensor still won't connect even with a new battery and after a reset while right next to the base station, and your other sensors are working fine, this indicates a possible hardware issue with this particular sensor. I'll escalate this to our advanced support team for further diagnosis and replacement if needed.

complaint: The workshop sensor will not report although it has good battery and was reset. I even put a brand new battery in and held it right against the base station while resetting it. The app shows it offline. The other sensors from the same box are perfect, so I don't think it is a setup problem.
usability_reason: The response is clear, polite, and actionable: it summarizes the symptoms accurately, explains the likely hardware cause, and escalates for diagnosis/replacement. It avoids claiming any checks or fixes were completed, since none were performed. It loses a point only because it offers no immediate customer-side step beyond escalation, but it is otherwise well-grounded in the reported facts.
